notes.title: Playable demo now available!
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce that a free playable demo of Typhon: Bot-vs-Bot is now available!

Community feedback is the most important factor for us in deciding how to build the game, so if you want to help, please give our demo a try then provide us with feedback either using the form available in the demo or right here on the forums. 

Also, please whishlist Typhon:BvB as the number of whishlists has a huge impact on the game's visibility on Steam.

The demo contains one single-player mission and it is currently available for the Microsoft Windows platform only.

Happy Coding!

The Brightshade Dev Team
